hero.lead: Welcome to a clinic where even the biggest fear of the dentist turns into a smile — modern equipment, a gentle approach and a team that truly cares.

services.title: Everything for your smile
services.lead: From regular check-ups to a complete smile makeover — eight services under one roof.

general.title: General dentistry
general.text: Check-ups, diagnostics and a clear treatment plan — the foundation of every healthy smile. Prevention is the best (and most affordable) dentistry.

fillings.title: Tooth fillings
fillings.text: Aesthetic tooth-colored fillings — precise, durable and completely painless.

endo.title: Root canal treatment
endo.text: We save even the teeth that seem lost — with modern endodontics.

extraction.title: Tooth extraction
extraction.text: When extraction is the only option: quick, careful and with gentle anesthesia.

prosthetics.title: Prosthetics
prosthetics.text: Crowns, bridges and dentures indistinguishable from natural teeth.

whitening.title: Teeth whitening
whitening.text: Professional whitening that is safe for enamel — a smile several shades brighter, often after the very first treatment.

scaling.title: Tartar removal
scaling.text: Ultrasonic cleaning and polishing for fresh breath and healthy gums.

kids.title: Pediatric dentistry
kids.text: A first visit without tears: through play, patience and a little reward for bravery. Kids leave our clinic with a smile — and gladly come back.

help.title: Not sure what you need?
help.text: Give us a call — we'll gladly advise you.

about.p1: Behind every healthy smile stands a patient heart. Dr. Kamala Ekmečić believes a visit to the dentist doesn't have to be stressful — that's why in our clinic there is always time for your questions, an explanation of every step and a break whenever you need one.
about.p2: With continuous education and modern equipment, we approach every patient individually — because every smile tells its own story.

team.p1: A new generation of the same dedication — Dr. Zehra brings fresh knowledge, a steady hand and a smile that puts you at ease already in the waiting room. She is especially loved by our youngest patients and by everyone whom fear of the dentist has kept away until now.
team.p2: Together we make sure every appointment goes calmly, thoroughly and ends with a smile.
team.sticker: a second pair of careful hands

tech.p1: The third pair of careful hands on our team — our technician prepares the clinic, assists with every procedure and makes sure everything is ready before you even sit in the chair.
tech.p2: The quiet strength of the clinic: with her around, every appointment starts on time and runs without a hitch.
tech.sticker: a third pair of hard-working hands

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.tip: Tip: on Thursdays we work in the afternoon — perfect if your mornings are busy.

bookingSection.lead: Fill out the form and we'll call you to confirm your appointment — usually the same day. No waiting, no complications.
bookingSection.messagesNote: We also reply to messages — feel free to write.

items.text: “For years I kept postponing the dentist out of fear. Here I relaxed for the first time — they explain everything, nothing hurts, and the staff is wonderful.”
items.name: Amira K.

items.text: “My daughter had her first check-up and can't wait for the next one! Who would have thought a child would beg to go to the dentist.”
items.name: Emir H.

items.text: “Professional, quick and no waiting. Tartar removed, teeth like new. Highly recommended!”
items.name: Selma B.

items.text: “My new crown looks so natural that even I can't tell the difference. Thank you for the patience and the perfect work!”
items.name: Jasmin M.

items.a: Honestly — no. We use modern anesthesia and techniques that make the procedure almost unnoticeable. And if you ever need a break, just raise your hand — we stop immediately.

items.q: What can I expect at the first check-up?
items.a: We get to know you and your teeth: a thorough examination, an X-ray if needed and a clear treatment plan with prices. No obligations and no surprises.
Of course — pediatric dentistry is our special love. We turn the first visit into a game: the child gets to know the clinic, takes a “ride” in the chair and receives a reward for bravery.
Cash or card, whatever suits you. For bigger treatments we can always arrange payment in installments — don't hesitate to ask.
